hash_boundaries.input_hash: accepted upstream lineage, exact hashes, cutoff/kickoff, schema/generator/config identity; excludes Frozen Input, Prediction, Engine Output, and volatile timestamps
hash_boundaries.feature_snapshot_hash: deterministic feature values/states/units/source refs/derivations plus schema/generator/config/cutoff scope; excludes declared volatile timestamps, Frozen Input, Prediction, and Engine Output
hash_boundaries.payload_hash: typed feature payload and explicit states

deterministic_replay: same logical accepted inputs produce the same hash
field order and collection order are canonical
any logical feature value/state/unit/source/derivation/schema/generator/config/cutoff change changes the snapshot hash
declared volatile timestamps are excluded only from the declared hash boundary
missingness_and_future_rules: UNKNOWN is not zero, mean, previous value, or empty-state coercion
UNAVAILABLE does not create a synthetic feature
CONFLICTED retains all source/evidence refs and is not silently resolved
BLOCKED is not a replacement value

boundaries.frozen_input: downstream_only; V4-076 not implemented in BATCH-10

acceptance_criteria: typed Feature Bundle v2 boundary and registry are stable
all seven feature categories are schema-governed
feature states and feature_quality semantics are explicit
Frozen Input is not required upstream
no prediction/model/engine fields enter the bundle
no implicit default, imputation, conflict selection, or future-data coercion
blocking_conditions: Frozen Input or V4-076 implementation becomes necessary
Production/Supabase access or migration is required
execution scope enters V4-041 or BATCH-11
